bind_address_help: 0.0.0.0 listens on all network interfaces. Alternatively enter the local IP of the ioBroker host. Do not enter a CIDR network here.
mqtt_port_help: A free TCP port, for example 1885. Do not use the same port as another MQTT broker.
allowed_clients_help: Optional: individual IPs or IPv4 networks in CIDR notation, e.g. 192.168.4.1/24. Separate multiple rules with commas. Empty allows all clients.
device_aliases_help: Maps short device IDs to display names, for example 001 = Hallway.
store_unknown_topics_help: Useful for new or unrecognized X-Sense messages.
log_messages: Show MQTT messages in the debug log
log_messages_help: May contain sensitive data and should only be enabled for troubleshooting.
restart_info: Changes to the IP, port or authentication take effect after restarting the adapter.
